title: Angles: Parallel Lines and Polygons
seo_title: Angles and Polygons – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find corresponding, alternate and co-interior angles with parallel lines; find the sum of interior and exterior angles of polygons. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on angles with parallel lines (corresponding, alternate, co-interior), naming polygons and interior and exterior angles of polygons. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • With parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal, alternate angles are equal and co-interior angles add up to 180°.
  • The interior angles of an n-sided polygon add up to (n − 2) × 180°.
  • The exterior angles of any polygon add up to 360°. In a regular polygon, each exterior angle = 360° ÷ n.

Examples

Example

Each interior angle of a regular hexagon

(6 − 2) × 180 = 720

720 ÷ 6

Answer: 120°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up alternate and co-interiorAlternate angles are on opposite sides (Z shape).
Using n × 180°It is (n − 2) × 180°.
Forgetting exterior + interior = 180°They lie on a straight line.
